name: free-search-mcp
description: Keyless Rust web, academic, and 500+ source search plus one-call ask, sandboxed JS exec, and doc reading.
long_description:
Single-binary Rust MCP server exposing exactly three keyless tools (`search`, `exec`, and `ask`) over 500+ web, academic, and specialist sources with no API key and no signup.

Use `ask` for quick one-call lookups returning dated passages or a sourced answer with no code. Use `search` for multi-engine web/vertical search, local FTS5 cache lookup, or zero-network catalog discovery. Use `exec` (QuickJS-NG ES2020 sandbox) to fetch and clean pages, read PDFs/Office/EPUB/archives, traverse scholarly citation graphs, check Retraction Watch integrity, fetch lawful open-access full text, generate offline citations, and call specialist APIs.

All three settings below are optional. Leave them empty unless your network needs a proxy. The binary automatically ignores empty or unfilled placeholder values.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyless multi-engine search over live verticals, local FTS5 cache, or the 500+ source & exec API catalog.

tools.name: exec
tools.description: Run sandboxed ES2020 JS (QuickJS-NG) with web, scholar, doc, source, cache, catalog, and util Host APIs.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Quick one-call lookup: direct-answer sources or parallel search+read passages, or a sourced answer when an answer agent is configured.

proxy.title: Proxy (optional)
proxy.description: Outbound proxy URL (http://, https://, socks5:// or socks5h://), only if your network blocks search engines. Leave empty otherwise.

region.title: Region (optional)
region.description: Default region-language for results, e.g. us-en, uk-en, cn-zh. Leave empty for us-en; a query's own language still wins.

cache_dir.title: Cache directory (optional)
cache_dir.description: Where fetched pages, searches, and Retraction Watch index are cached. Leave empty for ~/.cache/search-mcp.
